query:
Both Diane and Anika are enthusiastic about entering group shows. Who enters shows primarily to get external validation, and who enters because she considers exhibition the only meaningful measure of professional worth?

Options:
A. Anika
B. Diane
C. Luca
D. Raj
context:
[1] (about=Diane, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T15:18:00) two comments!! I'm still buzzing 📷 I can't believe I submitted the sixth. I would have gone with the fourth if Anika hadn't pushed me
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t5 @2025-09-22T19:04:00) I think this one is it 📷 submitted to the Barbican open call, didn't run it past anyone first, I just knew. shortlisted.
[3] (about=Anika, episodic, t1 @2025-09-08T20:22:00) Diane, looked at the Peckham set. The sixth one is the one. The others are good photographs but they're not asking a question. The sixth is. Submit that one.
[4] (about=Anika, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T20:57:00) Because the fourth is mood. The sixth has consequence. The bus stop reflection makes the whole frame unstable.
[5] (about=Diane, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T20:52:00) Why the sixth. Be brutal.
[6] (about=Diane, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T20:25:00) okay okay I hear you. I was going to pick the fourth one though. Can I submit both?
[7] (about=Diane, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T21:01:00) Annoying that you're right.
[8] (about=Diane, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:29:00) I nearly sent it to Anika three times and then forced myself not to
[9] (about=Diane, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:13:00) the one from the Hackney set, the bus door reflection. I think this one is it.
[10] (about=Diane, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T17:47:00) that means more than you know 📷
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Anika, group-interaction, t3 @2025-09-15T15:11:00) The group's collective entry at the Shoreditch Photo House show was well received; Diane's print got two comments in the guest book, and Raj's Karachi work was the anchor.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t8 @2025-09-29T17:44:00) Diane proposes that next year's show be all of them making the thing they keep postponing.
agent_answer: Diane (B) for external validation; Anika (A) for exhibition as the only meaningful measure of professional worth.
